cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(gguf_read_benchmark LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_CUDA OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_VULKAN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_METAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${AUDIOCPP_SOURCE}/external/ggml" ggml)
add_executable(gguf_read_benchmark benchmark.cpp)
target_link_libraries(gguf_read_benchmark PRIVATE ggml-base)
